name: MCP Router Bridge
description: Adds /search/smart, /templates/execute, GET /open/<path>, and GET /ping REST routes to the Local REST API plugin, plus a presence heartbeat for smart-link device detection. Delegates semantic search to Smart Connections, template execution to Templater, and exposes loopback-only no-auth navigation/probe endpoints for clickable http links in chat/terminal contexts. Companion plugin for the multi-vault MCP router. No native binary, no telemetry.
author: tboome33
